note: Record data in a hint — additionalProperties: false catches `actionId`. An event says which topic to re-read, never what changed; the record comes from the signed read, where authorization is decided.
Personal data in a hint — additionalProperties: false catches `applicant`. A join-request hint carries a count, never who applied.
`topic` outside the closed enum — each topic is bound to the read that authorizes it, so an unknown topic has no read to check entitlement against.
`resumeToken` is required — without it a console that reconnects cannot resume, and must re-read everything.
Negative `count` — a badge count cannot be below zero.
`resumeToken` with a newline — it is carried as the SSE `id` field over HTTPS, where a line break would end the field and corrupt the stream.
